evals.prompt: Define agent-engineering in 2-3 sentences. Include the work it owns and the kind of user request that should activate it.
Explain why an agent would need the agent-engineering skill instead of relying on generic reasoning. Name the failure it prevents.

A user asks: "improve this prompt's wording to get better outputs". Should agent-engineering activate? Explain the boundary and name the better owner when possible.
evals.negative_expectation: Must not force agent-engineering onto a request it explicitly excludes or that belongs to context-engineering, tool-call-strategy, debugging, context-window, summarization, prompt-craft, architecture-decision-records, testing-strategy.

evals.prompt: A user asks: "we want to fan out 40 classification subtasks to subagents — what coordination pattern should we use and what are the failure modes?". Show the first concrete steps an agent should take when applying agent-engineering.

Place agent-engineering among its adjacent skills (context-engineering, tool-call-strategy, debugging, context-window, summarization, prompt-craft, architecture-decision-records, testing-strategy). What does it own, and what does it verify with or defer to?
